text: Ko waɗi on onon gomɗimɓe ɓen feddeeji ɗiɗi e fii ɓee naafiqiiɓe : fedde goo hino wi'a waree ɓe sabu keeferaaku maɓɓe, fedde goo wi'a accireeɓe sabu gomɗiɗal maɓɓe ngal ! On haanaano luutondirde fii maɓɓe. Alla Ruttiriiɓe e keeferaaku sabu golle maɓɓe ɗen. E on faala fewnude on mo Alla Majjini laawol goonga ngol ?! Kala on mo Alla Majjini, a heɓaŋtaa mo fewnoowo.
